title: Feature Request: Deleting Dexcom queue entries
symptom: Sometimes there are queued entries like 'stop sensor' or 'calibrate ...' in the queue to the Dexcom transmitter (G6 or G5) that cannot be deleted. This can happen when a transmitter dies and the 'Stop Sensor' command gets stuck in the queue, preventing communication with a new transmitter.
cause: A command like 'stop sensor' remains in the queue because the transmitter is dead and never acknowledges the command, and there was no way to clear the queue.
fix: The capability now exists for clearing the Dexcom transmitter queue: Tap on the treatment menu (syringe symbol on the main screen), long press on the microphone symbol at the bottom right corner, and in the form that opens, enter 'clear transmitter queue'.
